 A decent run in the Asian swing of this year’s ATP Tour has established Adrian Mannarino as an intriguing pick to cover 2-0 sets against Aleksandar Vukic.
 Current Form:
 Adrian Mannarino reached the third round of the 2026 Shanghai Masters, picking up wins over Jerry Shang 7-6, 6-2 and world No.6 Flavio Cobolli 6-1, 4-6, 6-3 before falling to Karen Khachanov 2-6, 4-6 in the round of 32.
 Aleksandar Vukic could not make it through the qualifying rounds of the 2026 Shanghai Masters and lost in the second round of an ATP Challenger tournament in Jinan, China. Vukic is 20-18 on hard courts in 2026.
 The Matchup: Mannarino and Vukic are 2-2 in their head-to-head series. However, Mannarino has played much better tennis, going 5-3 in Asia so far.

 Our Adrian Mannarino vs Aleksandar Vukic Prediction
